verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an attorney-led immigration and startup law firm, not a software product with items a user could select and act on in bulk. Software-style bulk operations are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no self-serve tooling or API (OpenAPI probes all 404), and the firm positions itself against automated form tools in favor of accountable attorneys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
